remarks: MUST SEE!!! SPACIOUS & beautifully appointed Cape Cod comfortably set in the Town of Tonawanda, move-in ready with highly rated Ken-Ton schools & steps from Kenmore East High School. Featuring a renovated kitchen with attractive Oak cabinetry, brand new hardware and tastefully curated countertops opening to the formal dining room and the generous living room with wood paneled accent wall and an abundance of natural light throughout. The main floor bathrm has a tile shower surround and enjoy the master bedroom upstairs that serves as a private & peaceful getaway with walk-in closet area, sitting room & private bathroom. Step out the new sliding glass door onto the rear concrete patio, perfect for sipping your morning coffee and the convenient 1.5 car detached garage is ideal for storage! This charming and well-maintained property has a desirable layout for ease of living with updates including paint & sliding door 2026, patio 2021, HWT 2019, interior perimeter drain tile 2017, arch. shingle roof & electrical 2015, newer windows, Heil furnace and more. Calm & tranquility abound here in this PEACEFUL home, close to ALL the conveniences of the Boulevard yet w/room enough to breathe. Open Houses Saturday, 10/10/26 from 2:00-4:00 pm.
